Austria / Lech am Arlberg

Hotel & Chalet Aurelio

A boutique hotel in Lech, ski-in and ski-out, directly on the Schlegelkopf slope and a few minutes' walk from the centre. Next door, connected by an underground passage, the Club Chalet hosts up to 16 guests with a private chef and butler.

Enquire about this hotelAbout Lech am Arlberg
01 / 11

In short

What to know.

  • 10 Top Deluxe Double Rooms and Aurelio Suites, from 55 to 110 m²
  • More than 1,000 m² of spa, with a 23-metre indoor pool
  • The Club Chalet: eight rooms for up to 16 guests, with its own spa and indoor pool
  • At about 1,500 m, directly on the Schlegelkopf slope

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For guests who want to ski from the door of a small hotel, and for groups who want a chalet of their own with the hotel next door.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Hotel & Chalet Aurelio, under the hotel's terms.
